subject.title: WhatsApp channel: expose ctwa_clid from Click-to-WhatsApp ads in session metadata

question: Should WhatsApp CTWA attribution data be exposed only as per-turn untrusted structured context, also provided to plugin hooks, or persisted on session metadata for later Conversions API use?
rationale: The extraction is bounded, but the requested value is an advertising click identifier and the issue explicitly asks for prompt/session visibility, so automation should not choose the privacy, retention, and plugin-access boundary.

options.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
options.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context path without durable persistence.

options.title: Typed plugin-hook payload
options.body: Define an opted-in WhatsApp attribution payload for plugin hooks so a Conversions API plugin can consume it without putting the identifier into every agent prompt.

options.title: Persist session attribution
options.body: Store the first CTWA payload on session metadata only after defining explicit retention, redaction, and access rules.

recommendation.title: Per-turn untrusted context only
recommendation.body: Extract CTWA fields in the WhatsApp plugin and expose them only through the existing fenced untrusted structured-context path without durable persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans prompt metadata and session-retention boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the strongest routing candidate.
